findings.description: The delivered documentation contradicts the recorded delivery state. CHANGELOG.md:3 heads the release "0.1.0 - Unreleased" and CHANGELOG.md:8 states "No registry publication has occurred"; docs/STABILITY.md:3 says "The initial Rust version is 0.1.0, currently unpublished"; docs/SECURITY.md:58 says "The current unpublished workspace is the supported development line". All three are false at this source: README.md:16-18 and docs/RELEASE.md:3-8 advertise the crate as published, and docs/checks/release-registry-0.1.0.json:3-15 verifies crates.io scm-sdk 0.1.0 published 2026-10-17T01:14:40Z, owner cdot65, archive 6d555d955c3734dd..., embedded source commit 4f65dc48, with docs/checks/release-registry-execution-0.1.0.json recording 10 passing commands against that downloaded archive. docs/phase-status.json:1049-1056 also records registry_publication verified_existing_publication. The error direction is conservative (understating delivery), so it is not an overclaim, but phase 8's acceptance evidence is explicitly final documentation with no unexplained gaps, and these three files are the consumer-facing compatibility, changelog and security documents.
